intro.text: Good evening, and welcome in. It is game night.
Welcome to the arena. The building is packed tonight.
Lights are down, the crowd is up. Let's play some basketball.
Good evening, everybody. We've got a good one for you tonight.

intro_ana.text: Two teams that like to get out and run. Should be fun.
Ball movement is going to decide this one.
I want to see who controls the glass tonight.

three_ana.text: That's what spacing does for you.
You leave a shooter open, you pay for it.
Perfect rotation of the ball, and the right man got it.
Leave him open and that is what happens.
Feet set, eyes on the rim. Money.

dunk.text: Oh, what a finish at the rim!

dunk_ana.text: Nobody wanted any part of that.
Attack the basket like that, good things happen.
That's how you take it to the rim.
That gets the whole bench up.
You feel that one in the cheap seats.

jumper_ana.text: That's a tough shot, and he makes it look easy.
The mid-range game is still alive.
That mid-range game is a lost art.
He got to his spot and rose up.

and1.text: Gets the bucket, and the foul!

miss_ana.text: Good look. It just did not fall.
He rushed that one a little.

block_ana.text: Timing on that block was perfect.
Perfect timing. He waited for it.
That will make them think twice.

steal.text: He took it right from him!

steal_ana.text: Active hands. That's what you want.
Read that pass all the way.
Lazy pass, and they made them pay.
Quick hands. He was waiting on that.
Careless with the ball, and he paid for it.

turnover_ana.text: Got to take better care of the ball there.
Too much dribbling on that possession.
You cannot give away possessions like that.

shotclock.text: They couldn't get a shot off in time.

foul.text: He got him on the arm.
Contact, and the official calls it.

shake.text: He lost him with the crossover!

hot.text: Somebody put a hand up, he is on fire!

hot_ana.text: When you see a couple go in, the rim starts looking like an ocean.
That's confidence. You can see it.
Just keep giving him the ball.
The basket looks like an ocean to him.

run.text: Timeout might be coming. This is a run.
They are on a run, and this building is rocking.

end_q.text: That'll do it for the quarter.
End of the quarter here at the arena.

half.text: We'll take a break with this one going to the half.

half_ana.text: Second half adjustments are going to decide this.
Got to clean up the turnovers coming out of the break.

clutch.text: Here we go. Every possession matters now.

clutch_ana.text: This is where your best players have to step up.
Execution wins this. Get a good look.
That is who you want with the ball late.

buzzer.text: Beat the buzzer! Are you kidding me?!
At the horn! He got it!

final.text: And that will do it. What a night.

final_ana.text: Great effort on both ends tonight.
A lot to like from that performance.

It's the postseason, and this building is electric.
Welcome to the playoffs. Every possession matters now.

g7.text: Game seven. Win or go home.
It all comes down to this. Game seven.

elim.text: Facing elimination tonight. Their season is on the line.
Lose tonight, and the season is over.

closeout.text: One more win, and they move on.

rival.text: Tonight, a rivalry renewed. These two came into the league together.
Same draft class, same division, and they hate losing to each other.

debut.text: Here's the rookie, in his first game in the league.
A big night for the rookie. His debut.

allstar.text: Welcome to the All-Star Game. The best in the world, all on one floor.

contest_intro.text: Ladies and gentlemen... the Three-Point Contest!

timeout_ana.text: Good time for a breather. Regroup and go.

postup_ana.text: Big man going to work on the block.

double.text: Here comes the double team. Find the open man.

subs_ana.text: The coach goes to his bench here.

showoff.text: Nobody near him, and he puts on a show!

daily_intro.text: Crunch time. This is the moment.
Final seconds. Everything comes down to this.

lead.text: And that gives them the lead!
Lead change! What a game we have.

lead_ana.text: That is a momentum bucket right there.
Now go get a stop and make it count.

perfect_ana.text: That release was perfect. He knew it.
Textbook form. Same shot every time.
You could hear that one snap the net.

blowby.text: Got a step, and he is gone!
Left his man in the dust!

blowby_ana.text: You cannot guard that first step.
He set him up, then went the other way.

ankles.text: He put him on the floor!

ankles_ana.text: That is going to be all over the internet.
He is going to hear about that one.

poster.text: Oh my! He dunked on him!
Right over the top of him!

poster_ana.text: Do not jump with him. Just do not.
Frame that one and hang it up.

deep.text: He pulled up from the logo!

deep_ana.text: You have to pick him up at half court.
There is no bad shot for him tonight.

dime.text: He saw that before anyone else did.

dime_ana.text: He draws two and finds the open man.

chasedown.text: Chase-down block! Where did he come from?
From behind! He pinned it on the glass!

board.text: He goes up and gets it.

playcall_ana.text: They are running a set here. Watch the weak side.
Good call out of the timeout.
Nice design. Everybody knows their spot.

zone_ana.text: They have gone to a zone. Move the ball.
A zone look now. Somebody has to hit a shot.

trap_ana.text: Here comes the trap. Get rid of it.
They are sending two at the ball.

blowout_ana.text: This one is getting away from them.
They need a run, and they need it now.

close_ana.text: Buckle up. This is going down to the wire.
One possession game. Every trip matters.

start_q.text: And we are back at it.

crossed_ana.text: Stay down and move your feet.

wall_ana.text: Great job walling off the lane.
Nothing easy at the rim tonight.

finals_intro.text: Welcome to the Finals. It does not get bigger than this.

finals_intro_ana.text: Everything they have worked for comes down to this.
Legacies are made on this floor.

cup_intro.text: Welcome to the Cup final. One game, one trophy.
Win tonight and the Cup is yours.

cup_intro_ana.text: No series, no second chances. Just tonight.

champ.text: It is over! They are the champions!
Raise the trophy! What a moment!

champ_ana.text: They earned every bit of that.
Nobody can ever take this away from them.

st_debut_bench.text: The rookie starts his first game on the bench tonight. He will have to wait for his number to be called.
A debut tonight, but not in the starting five. The rookie will come off the bench.

st_first_start.text: A big night for him. For the first time, he is in the starting five.
He has earned it. Tonight is his first start.

st_first_start_ana.text: You never forget your first start. Let's see what he does with it.

st_sixth_first.text: He has moved up. Tonight he is the first man off the bench.
More minutes for him tonight. He is the sixth man now.

st_first_bench.text: Something new for him tonight. He comes off the bench for the first time.
He is not in the starting five tonight. A first for him.

st_benched.text: He has lost his starting spot. Tonight he comes off the bench with something to prove.
A change in the lineup tonight. He starts this one on the bench.

st_benched_ana.text: How a player answers that tells you everything about him.

st_promoted.text: He is back in the starting five tonight.
The coach has put him back with the starters.

st_newteam.text: A new uniform for him tonight. His first game with his new team.
New city, new colors. Tonight he plays for his new team for the first time.

st_newteam_ana.text: First impressions matter. His new teammates are watching.

st_former.text: This one is personal. He faces his old team tonight.
He knows that other bench well. Tonight he plays the team that let him go.

st_former_ana.text: Do not tell me that one does not mean a little more.

st_return.text: Good news tonight. He is back at full strength.
He has been playing hurt, and tonight he is finally healthy.

st_opener.text: Opening night. A brand new season starts right here.
Welcome back, everybody. A new season is here.

st_afterhigh.text: He is coming off the best game of his career. Can he do it again?
Everybody saw what he did last time out. A career night.

st_rolling.text: He comes in red hot. Twenty or more in three straight games.
Nobody has been able to slow him down lately.

st_rolling_ana.text: When a scorer is in that kind of rhythm, you just keep feeding him.

st_bounce.text: He will want this one. It was a rough night for him last time out.
A chance to bounce back tonight after a quiet game.

st_streak_w.text: This team is rolling. Winners of four or more in a row.
They come in on a winning streak, and they are feeling good.

st_streak_l.text: They need this one badly. It has been a rough stretch of losses.
A losing streak on the line tonight. Somebody has to stop it.

st_rematch.text: They owe this team one. It did not go their way the last time they met.
A rematch tonight, and they have not forgotten the last one.

st_again.text: This defense remembers him. He lit them up the last time.
He had a big night against this team last time. They will be ready for him.

st_b2b.text: Second night of a back to back. Tired legs out there tonight.
They played last night too. We will see how much is left in the tank.

st_checkin.text: Here he comes, off the bench.
And he is into the game.

st_checkin_first.text: And here he comes, off the bench for the first time.
He checks in. Let's see how he handles the new role.

st_checkin_debut.text: Here he comes! The rookie checks in for his first minutes in the league.
This is the moment. The rookie is coming into the game for the first time.

st_checkin_debut_ana.text: Deep breath, kid. It is the same game you have always played.
You only get one first time. Enjoy it.

st_first_pts.text: And there it is! His first points in the league!
He is on the board! The first bucket of his career!

st_first_pts_ana.text: Keep that ball. He is going to want it.
The first of many. You can see the weight come off his shoulders.

st_statement.text: Twenty for him tonight! What a way to answer.
He has twenty, on a night that was all about him.

st_statement_ana.text: That is a statement. He belongs out here.
You could not have written it any better for him.
